description: This file defines functions and types for handling scheduling options in a CLI, including resolving, normalizing, and applying cron schedule configurations.

methods.name: resolveCronCreateSchedule
methods.description: Resolves and validates a cron schedule based on provided options, ensuring exactly one schedule type is chosen.

methods.name: resolveCronEditScheduleRequest
methods.description: Creates a request to edit or patch an existing cron schedule based on options.

methods.name: applyExistingCronSchedulePatch
methods.description: Applies a patch request to an existing cron schedule, returning the updated schedule.

methods.name: normalizeScheduleOptions
methods.description: Normalizes raw schedule options, parsing and validating input values.

methods.name: countChosenSchedules
methods.description: Counts how many schedule options are selected among 'at', 'every', and 'cron'.

methods.name: resolveDirectSchedule
methods.description: Resolves a direct schedule object from normalized options, validating constraints.

methods.name: readOptionalString
methods.description: Reads and trims an optional string value.

methods.name: readTrimmedString
methods.description: Reads a value as a string and trims whitespace.
